prepared_for: Magali Rady, Jad Chbeir and the YKONE Middle East team
title: Egypt — a few ideas for YKONE
subject: Egypt — a few ideas for YKONE
body:
Hi Jad and Amal,

Following our call on 8 October, I have put together a few pages on how NOYA could work with YKONE in Egypt.

The idea is simple: YKONE leads the client relationship and the creative vision, and we bring the Egypt side to life, from shoots and creator trips to hosted dinners at Giza.

Giza is busy this autumn and the Grand Egyptian Museum marks its first year on 5 November. If a brief with an Egypt angle comes up this quarter or next, send it over with the dates and we will build the Egypt layer around it.

Best,
Adam Elshazly
Founder, NOYA Concierge
noyaconcierge.com

sources.fact: YKONE is looking at the Egypt market and asked for a call.
sources.source: Gmail: Magali Rady to noya@, 29 Sep 2026

sources.fact: Call held with Jad Chbeir (Commercial Director) and Amal on 8 Oct; NOYA Overview and Egypt Partner Guide sent the same day.
sources.source: Gmail: noya@ to Jad and Amal, 8 Oct 2026; CRM opportunity ea415161

sources.fact: "YKONE leads the creative vision and brand relationships, while NOYA brings together the right people, places and experiences to make it happen."
Idea already offered in Adam's follow-up draft: a private brand dinner beside the Pyramids or at the Grand Egyptian Museum, with talent hosting by NOYA.
sources.source: Gmail draft (unsent), recorded in the CRM 15 Oct 2026

sources.fact: YKONE is part of ONE Group, formed in January 2026 with Mirror Mirror (creative production) and others; the group has since taken a stake in BYSELECT, a UAE experiential agency.
sources.source: Net Influencer and Entrepreneur coverage of ONE Group, 2026

sources.fact: No reply from YKONE since 8 Oct.
The Longines Global Champions Tour holds its first Egypt event at the Pyramids of Giza, 22–24 October 2026, the first year of a five-year agreement.
Forever Is Now 06, Art D’Égypte’s open-air exhibition on the Giza plateau, runs 4–28 November 2026.
Shakira performs at the Pyramids of Giza on 28 November 2026.
sources.source: Ticket Egypt, official ticketing for Venture Lifestyle (HQ calendar, verified)

sources.fact: The Grand Egyptian Museum marks its first anniversary on 5 November 2026 with Gala de Danza, the company’s first performance in the Middle East.
sources.source: Ticketsmarche, official ticketing presented by GEM Experience (HQ calendar, verified)

sources.fact: The 47th Cairo International Film Festival runs 11–20 November 2026.
No reply from YKONE since 8 Oct (12 days). Adam edited the follow-up draft in Gmail on 19 Oct; it is unsent.
sources.source: Gmail thread 1a11c1544306c7b1 and draft r3413834542155918452, checked 20 Oct 2026

review: Adam's 21 Oct subject: a new email, not a reply in the 8 Oct thread. It replaces the earlier follow-up draft r3413834542155918452 (same draft, updated), so there is one YKONE draft.
The brief goes with it as a PDF; the text does not say attached.
